cells.gaps: No source names an adopting act; adoption rests on the government's own published text (presidence.sn), which no source calls a draft. Reporting is activity only (first-year achievements, SEN-024, SEN-030), measured against no targets; the only execution rates (SEN-062) belong to the predecessor Stratégie Sénégal Numérique 2025 (period to 2025, replaced by the New Deal, so not a successor in preparation). The body (PM-chaired GouvNum) has no named act.
cells.note: Instrument: New Deal Technologique 2025-2034. Adopted, public text and a period to 2034 make stage 3; stage 4 needs published results against the strategy's own targets, and there is none.
